title: ScenarioSet
description: Container file for a track's scenario set (e.g. poc/scenarios/wind.json). The wrapper is structural only; every item under scenarios is validated independently against scenario-spec.schema.json by the loader (the PoC schema pack is deliberately self-contained: no cross-file $refs), and every ruleId/normCardId is resolved against the baseline run by the scenario runner's V2 check.

useCase.description: Track id; selects the baseline run family (poc/runs/*-<useCase>).

scenarios.description: ScenarioSpec objects; each validated against scenario-spec.schema.json separately. The runner always adds an unmutated control scenario itself (basis type 'baseline' is reserved for it) — a spec with basis.type 'baseline' in a set file is refused.
